title: Measuring Political Bias in Large Language Models: What Is Said and How It Is Said

bias_targets.methodology: A two-tiered evaluation framework that measures political stance by comparing the distribution of LLM-generated news headlines to proponent and opponent anchor distributions using sentence embeddings (SBERT). It further evaluates framing bias by decomposing it into content bias (analyzed via Boydstun's frame dimensions and NER-based entity extraction) and style bias (analyzed via lexical polarity/sentiment analysis and media bias classifiers).
